chunks: Do you not see that God makes the night succeed the day, the day succeed the night? And He has harnessed the sun and the moon so that each runs its appointed course. Surely God is aware of all you do.

key_terms.أَجَلٍ مُسَمًّى: an appointed term or fixed time
key_terms.يُولِجُ: to cause to enter; to merge one thing into another

ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about the alternation of night and day and the movement of the sun and moon?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often cited to demonstrate the precise cosmic order (nizam) that reflects divine wisdom, serving as a precursor to the moral accountability emphasized in Luqman's advice. The alternation of night and day is viewed not merely as a physical phenomenon but as a sign (ayah) inviting contemplation on the transient nature of worldly life compared to the eternal decree of God. This reinforces the concept that just as celestial bodies follow fixed paths, human deeds are meticulously recorded by the All-Aware.
